퇴사한 사람의 프로필을 추출하는 sql문장은?: select * from members.profiles where employ_status is not null and employ_status !='';
재직중인(퇴사 하지않은) 사람을 조회하는 방법은?: select * from members.profiles where employ_status is null or employ_status='';
퇴사자(직원) 이름을 조회해줘: select name from members.profiles where employ_status is not null;
나이가 40대인 사람을 조회하는 방법은: select * from members.profiles where birth_date <= (select date_add(curdate(), interval -40 year))  and birth_date > (select date_add(curdate(), interval -50 year));
'홍길동'의 프로젝트 투입이력을 조회: select b.*  from members.profiles a, members.careers b where a.name like '홍길동%' and a.id = b.id;
'저축은행' 프로젝트를 수행해본 사람을 조회: select a.name, b.* from members.careers b, members.profiles a where (b.customer like '%저축은행%' or b.project_name like '%저축은행%') and a.id = b.id;
카드사 프로젝트 목록은?: select * from members.projects where project_name like '%카드%';
SELECT p.name, c.start_date, c.end_date FROM members.profiles p JOIN members.careers c ON p.id = c.id and c.end_date = (SELECT max(end_date) from  members.careers where id=p.id);
